top_signals.title: China exports, imports soar past expectations in October — surplus narrows sharply
top_signals.summary: Goods exports soared by 35.2% last month from a year earlier, exceeding expectations for a 33.5% jump in a Reuters poll and slowing from a 36.3% jump in September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
